title: Lawn Care Follow-Up Visit Checklist Form
subtitle: Control mowing, cultivation, irrigation review, treatment, and property handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete lawn care follow-up visit checklist for turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment. It connects service plan, product label, site map, and instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified lawn-care technician or applicator must compare a current lawn care condition with prior service evidence, decide whether it is planned, recurring, incomplete, or new, and assign the next action.

sections.title: Lawn Care follow-up visit checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This lawn care follow-up visit checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when weather, chemical labeling, people or pets, hidden utilities, slope, equipment guarding, property boundary, or treatment condition is uncertain. A turf, pesticide, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
